QuestInfo.name: The Ticket Hunt Ends
QuestInfo.0: Another string of busts. It's not easy to win a ticket to Blake's autograph event, but Enin still refuses to give up.
QuestInfo.1: One last shot! Enin wants you to bring back 60 Autograph Ticket Coupons from the Melon Bubble Teas this time. Will she give up if this one doesn't work out...?
QuestInfo.2: Finally, a ticket to Blake's autograph event!

0.0: Blake, you're definitely a hard man to get at...but I'm not giving up yet! Could you help me out one more time? I promise it'll be the last... I can't do this forever.

yes.0: This is the final stand! Could you hunt #rMelon Bubble Teas#k and bring back #b60#k Autograph Ticket Coupons? Supposedly Blake really dislikes the melon flavor, but maybe he put in a winning ticket in one of those bubble teas anyway.

no.0: Pretty please! Just one more...Please! It'll be the last time, I promise!

1.0: This is it... The moment of truth. Here... We... Go!

yes.3: ...(She STILL silently scratches at the tickets. Will this ever--)
yes.4: O-oh... Oh my... I WON! I WONNNNNNN!! Ah, I can FINALLY MEET THE LOVE OF MY LIFE!
yes.5: I'm so happy that I won. Thank you so much, this is all thanks to you!

item.0: I need 60 Signing Event Ticket Coupons from the Melon Bubble Teas! Black doesn't like them much...so it's the perfect place to hide a ticket!
